proposal.title: Investigation into Ai diamond detection: An Agentic AI Framework for High-Assurance Decision Systems
proposal.executive_summary: This research proposal presents a novel agentic methodology to address fundamental challenges in Ai diamond detection. Operating out of xxxx, the project unites automated multi-agent coordination with verifiable domain guardrails, achieving measurable improvements over current industry benchmarks. The initiative directly targets core objectives in Ai by deploying verifiable experimental pipelines.
proposal.methodology: The methodology combines hierarchical agent orchestration with retrieval-augmented generation and deterministic tool validation. Agent roles are segmented into perception, planning, tool-assisted action, and automated safety verification.
